Wrote the 4.2.0 entry at the top of `CHANGELOG.md`, dated 2026-08-25.

Of 380 commits, 47 touch behavior. The rest are dependency bumps, tests, CI, and refactors that move code without changing it.

Three things need your call before you ship:

| Item | Why it needs you |
|---|---|
| Node version | Five commits say "note the minimum node version" but only touch docs. CI moved to Node 22. Nothing changed `engines` in `package.json`, so I did not claim a bump. |
| v1 export route | The commit calls it "unused." If it was public, this is breaking as written. If it never shipped, cut that bullet. |
| Perf bullet | It sits under **Added** because your template has no fourth heading. Move or drop it. |

Twelve commits drop a "v2 debug helper" from `src/`. I left those out as internal. Worth a glance if any were exported.
